items.name: kuiper-theme
items.title: Kuiper theme
items.description: Kuiper's tokens for light and dark: colour, radius, spacing, type, motion, focus and the groove.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

& > [data-slot=\"four-dot-dot\"].animation: kuiper-mark-dock calc(var(--motion-entrance) * var(--motion-entrance-dot)) both, kuiper-mark-fade calc(var(--motion-entrance) * var(--motion-entrance-dot)) both

&::after.background: radial-gradient(160px circle at var(--glass-x, 50%) var(--glass-y, 0%), var(--glass-light), transparent 70%)

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist
items.description: Geist, the body face, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: font-heading-ibm-plex-sans
items.title: IBM Plex Sans
items.description: IBM Plex Sans, the heading face, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: font-jetbrains-mono
items.title: JetBrains Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono, the face for labels, code and data, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn class-merging helper and the prop-type helpers that components import.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: four-dot
items.title: Four-dot mark
items.description: The Pluto Systems four-dot mark and the wordmark lockup, sized by the text around them.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The light and dark switch: a head script that sets the theme before paint, a store that follows the system until a choice is made, and a toggle button.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: read-token
items.title: Read token
items.description: Reads the theme's runtime variables from script: a token's value, a duration in milliseconds, an easing curve, and a tween that animates a number over them.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: Liquid glass
items.description: A frosted panel for expressive pages: an edge lit where the pointer moves, and an opaque ground under reduced transparency or forced colours. Needs Svelte 5.29 or later, for attachments.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action: the surface's one blue primary, a bordered secondary, ghost, destructive or link, at 48 or 32 px, with a busy state that keeps focus.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short inverted label that opens on hover and focus, closes on Escape, and repeats an icon button's name.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key, or a group of keys, set in the mono face on an inset.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that says whether it is pressed, inverted when it is.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row of toggles, one stop for the row, moved by the arrow keys, for one choice or several.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: A named group of related buttons, joined edge to edge or spaced in a row, each its own Tab stop.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label you can remove or press, in a named list that moves focus to its neighbour when a tag is removed.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A raised surface with a header, content, footer and an action, whose title is a real heading.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The groove between sections, decorative by default, or a plain vertical hairline.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, content and actions, plain or outlined, that can be one link.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table with a caption, header, selectable rows and a footer, scrolling inside itself when it must.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels as a pill strip on an inset or as underlined triggers, moved by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A button that shows and hides a region, with its state in aria-expanded.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's image or initials at the case radius, alone or in an overlapping group.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small dialog anchored to its button, raised by the elevation shadow, that returns focus when it closes.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Headings that each open a section, divided by grooves, moved by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in default, destructive, success or caution, whose role matches how urgent it is.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A modal confirm on the scrim that traps focus, starts on Cancel and closes on Escape.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small mono label that names a state in words, outlined in its state colour.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state: an icon tile, a heading, a sentence and the next action.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A static, hidden placeholder on an inset where content is loading.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A turning icon for the one control that is busy, decorative by default or announced with a label.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: An empty polite live region, present from the first render, whose text the app sets.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error summary
items.description: The box a failed submit puts at the top of a form: a heading, the form's message and a link to each invalid field, focused when it appears.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress bar
items.description: A task's progress as the native progress bar, on the muted track with a primary fill, its numbers written beside it.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short message in the corner, spoken by one of two announcers, that never covers the focus; success and info leave after at least 6 s, and everything else waits to be dismissed.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label in sentence case, dimmed with its disabled control.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, control, description and error, wired to the control by id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A 48 px text input on the raised ground with a visible border and a red one when invalid.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its text where the browser can.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input or textarea with text or button addons, one focus ring around the group, and a password toggle.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled as an input, with a caret.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 24 px checkbox that tells checked and mixed by shape as well as colour.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Round radios in a group with one stop, moved and chosen by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off setting: a blue track with a thumb that moves to the end.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A six-digit code in 48 px cells over one real input that accepts a pasted code.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search input with a magnifier, a clear button and Escape to clear, that can speak the result count for what is typed now.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code, output or a diff on the code ground, edged by the hairline, highlighted from the code tokens, with line numbers, a copy button and a header divided by the groove.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code editor
items.description: A CodeMirror 6 editor themed from the tokens and coloured by the highlighter, with line numbers and Python, that prerenders as plain code and leaves Tab unbound.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: Code highlighted in Meridian's roles: tree-sitter with this system's own queries for 21 languages, Shiki for the rest and as the fallback, every colour a code token, for the server or the browser.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use highlighted code
items.description: A hook that highlights a changing string line by line as it grows.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: code-languages
items.title: Code languages
items.description: Any of the highlighter's twenty-six languages for the editor, loaded on demand: a table of ids, aliases and kinds, and loadLanguage.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A figure for layerchart with a name and a table of its data, series coloured by token classes, and a tooltip on the elevation shadow.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, as the native meter on the muted track with a primary fill, its numbers written beside it.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu opened from a button, on the elevation shadow, moved by the arrow keys, with check and radio items and a shortcut written in words.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel fixed to one edge of the screen, named by its title, behind the scrim, that returns focus when it closes.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window named by its title, behind the scrim, for a task that must finish before the page goes on.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current page as a list of links, the current page marked and not a link.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A navigation landmark on the paper ground, set apart by a vertical groove, that collapses off-canvas or to icons and becomes a sheet on a phone.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: is-mobile
items.title: Is mobile
items.description: A media-query store that is true below 768 px and false on the server.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: The inline link: always underlined, in the primary colour or the text's, with standalone, new-tab and visited forms.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A named nav of page links, or page buttons for a list paged in place, with the current page marked and Previous and Next omitted at the ends.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: message-log
items.title: Message log
items.description: A scroll box named "Messages" holding a named log, that follows new content until the reader scrolls away, with a button back to the end.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn of a conversation: a heading that says who, the content as full-width prose or a bubble on the muted inset, and a footer.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that is not a turn: a status, a divider, a note.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The form a person writes a message in: a textarea that grows, Enter to send, a send button that becomes Stop while a reply runs, and never a disabled control.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: stage
items.title: Stage
items.description: A full-bleed expressive section on the canvas or one of the four colour fields, following the page's theme.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: stage-card
items.title: Stage card
items.description: Code on a flat card for a stage, with a copy button and, given a run function, a Run button whose output and outcome the card shows and says.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: marketing-bar
items.title: Marketing bar
items.description: A product site's sticky top bar, a floating glass panel: a skip link, the logo, named links and actions, folding into a sheet on a phone.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: stage-hero
items.title: Stage hero
items.description: A page's first screen on a stage: an eyebrow, the display heading, a sentence and actions on glass, an object on a colour field, and a strip along the bottom.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: proof-band
items.title: Proof band
items.description: Two to four numbers in the proof step, each with what it counts, that count up once when they first come into view.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: live-console
items.title: Live console
items.description: A working console shown on a stage: example commands in tabs, a Run button, meters that fill to the result, and its lines.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: name-strip
items.title: Name strip
items.description: A named list of names in mono that wraps, for the bottom of a hero.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: cta-band
items.title: Call to action band
items.description: A closing section: a heading in the section step, an optional sentence and one or two actions.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: marketing-footer
items.title: Marketing footer
items.description: A product site's footer: the logo, groups of links each a named nav, and the build facts the app shell's footer shows.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A page's opening: an optional eyebrow, the one heading, a sentence, one call to action, and a feature grid divided by grooves.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: Email and password in one step, with an error summary that takes focus, a password you can show, and a button that goes busy.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign up
items.description: Email and a password with its rules written first, then a six-digit code on its own step, with resend.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: page-states
items.title: Page states
items.description: Empty, loading, error and not found as one family, with an error page for SvelteKit's error route.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: One column of sections divided by grooves, saved by one button, with an inline Saved message and a confirmed delete.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The frame every page sits in: a skip link, a header with the product's logo or name and a theme toggle, an optional sidebar, the main area, and a footer that states the build.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A conversation: a log that follows new replies, turns with code, a composer that sends and stops, and the words a screen reader hears.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: product-home
items.title: Product home
items.description: A product's home page: the glass bar, a stage hero with two code cards on a colour field and a strip, a proof band, a live console on a stage, a call to action and the footer.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>

items.name: pluto-theme
items.title: Pluto theme (renamed)
items.description: Renamed kuiper-theme in 0.13.0. Installs kuiper-theme. This alias is removed in 0.14.0.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
